title: The False Quarry
text: The thing in the clearing looks like the quarry, down to the scar on its flank, and is not. Its movements are a beat too late. It is wearing the quarry's shape, the way a man wears a borrowed coat, and it is waiting to see if you will notice.

options.label: Strike it anyway. Whatever it is, it is not friendly.

outcomes.text: It sheds the quarry's shape like a coat, and what is underneath fights.

options.label: The sharpest eye watches it, and waits for it to lead you true.

outcomes.text: It leads you to the real one without ever knowing it, and you leave it to its borrowed shape.

options.label: The smoothest speaks to the thing in the borrowed shape, curious what it wants.

outcomes.text: It wants the quarry dead too, and it walks with you a while, close enough to touch.
